about: Cross-language fixtures of the vibesys-evaluator core, written from the Python implementation the Go core replaced (vibesys-evaluator 0.2.0rc1): HDR histogram summaries and merges, result-protocol-2 record streams byte for byte, Metric and Validity rules, sample seeds. Read by go/evaluator and by the Python tests, which run the core through the wrapper. Non-finite numbers are the strings NaN, Infinity and -Infinity.
